text:
amal: Postmortem notes from last night's KMS/principal tightening and ptls enforcement canary. Summarizing root cause, mitigation, and follow-ups.

kevin: Root cause: infra PR narrowed KMS decrypt principals but one rotator job in apac-staging still ran with the old SA. DecryptAccessDenied surfaced as keystore unwrap errors.

sam: Symptoms: multiple keystore unwrap failures in apac-staging and a ~3% spike in /internal/auth 403s. Log excerpt: `kms:DecryptAccessDenied principal=svc-rotator-legacy@apac-staging`

ops-oncall: incident-bot: canary alert triggered at 2026-03-18T14:10Z, 12 unwrap failures in 10m.

amal: Immediate mitigation: kevin applied a conditional KMS decrypt grant for the legacy rotator SA with explicit expiry and created ticket SEC-8892. Unwraps recovered.

dylan: Post-incident analysis: deployment drift and incomplete SA rotation caused the mismatch. We lacked job-level correlation IDs which slowed root cause mapping.

marie: Impact: short-lived auth errors regionally; no user-facing data exposure. Edge pods missing client certs fallback to clientless TLS which triggered the 403s.

sam: Remediations in flight: (1) instrument rotator with ROTATOR_REQ_ID and include it in unwrap logs and KMS request metadata, (2) add metric ptls.client_cert_missing with canary thresholds, (3) run SA inventory and mark any legacy SAs for rotation.

dylan: Process changes: RBAC hardening playbook draft will include: SA inventory, decrypt smoke tests per principal, conditional-grant-only fallback pattern, 30m canary in a single region, and mandatory audit ticket + expiry for any temporary grants. ETA 48h.

kevin: Operational tasks: remove the temporary KMS grant once all rotators are updated (auto-reminder set), backfill audit entries with correlation IDs where possible, and add a preflight job to detect jobs still using legacy SAs.

audit-bot: reminder: all KMS policy modifications must reference ticket SEC-8892 (or successor) and include expiry condition.

amal: Next steps: circulate playbook, schedule a dry-run in staging with full telemetry, then sign off on global ptls enforcement window. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
